qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Subsidiaries dominate tight B2B technical niches where mission-critical components represent a negligible fraction of customer spend but carry high switching penalties. Pricing power is demonstrated by gross margin stability (>35%) and sustained ~19% GAAP ROIC.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Premier Swedish decentralized serial acquirer of niche B2B market leaders. Exceptional capital allocation under CEO Jörgen Wigh with self-funded bolt-on M&A, ~19% GAAP ROIC, >100% FCF conversion, and net debt easily repayable in ~2.5 years of Owner FCF. [5-10Y g: organic volume 3.0% + niche pricing power 2.0% + bolt-on acquisitions 4.5% + buybacks 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 4-year median GAAP ROIC is 19.17% with tangible ROIC approaching 200%. FY2025 Owner FCF reached SEK 1,288M on Net Income of SEK 1,200M (FCF conversion 117.7%). Net debt of SEK 3,173M is ~2.64x net income, supported by SEK 1,696M EBIT and 9.8x interest coverage. M&A is fully self-financed via internal operating cash flow.
